text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rewinding back a few weeks.
On Tracen Island—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
As of today, Tamamo Cross is appointed
as the leader of the student Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Don't you guys go giving Tama trouble, got it?!
Listen carefully to what she says and do your work!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Well, back home I was pretty much the leader of the house! Just leave it all to me!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Look at you all motivated, what a good girl~
Tama-chan, good girl, good girl~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, some time had passed since Tamamo Cross was appointed leader—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That makes no sense!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I became the leader, right?
And I've been doing this and that all over the place, right?
And in the middle of all that—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Group A, just like yesterday, you're on leveling duty in this area!
Keep an eye on your surroundings like always, alright?
Any questions before we get started?"

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"It's alright, leave it to us! Tama-chan is doing her best as leader,
so we're gonna give it our all too!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Whoa...
You'll do your best if I do my best as leader...?

text_block_list.name: Vendor Lady
text_block_list.text:
"—Here are the overview and work schedule
for the new training facility project."

text_block_list.name: Vendor Lady
text_block_list.text:
And the parts highlighted in yellow are the tasks for the
Umamusume joining from the Academy...
Tama-chan, could you share this with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right, someone brought up an opinion yesterday.
About the island training—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's up? Everyone's smilin' so much...
Is there somethin' on my face?

text_block_list.name: Vendor Lady
text_block_list.text:
! Oh, ah, sorry, sorry!
It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"So yeah, everyone's acting super weird!
What is up with that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later,
the true nature of what felt "off" about Tamamo Cross
was revealed in an unexpected way!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Tama-chan isn't
a new student this year!?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A new studeeent!?

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "B-Because look, Super Creek-san was patting his head too..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, Creek's the kind of girl who wants
to pamper even full-grown adults!
To begin with—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm in the same school year as Creek, dammit!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeee!?
I-I-I-Is that really... nan desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's true. Tracen Academy is massive, after all.
It's only natural there are things you didn't know.
Tama is my classmate.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She wakes me up during class and goes to
buy bread with me during breaks.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She helps me look for erasers when I drop them,
and reminds me when I forget classroom duty!
She's a classmate you can really count on!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
S-So that's how it was...!
I'm so sorry, Tama-chan... I mean, Ms. Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. As long as ya get it, it's all good!
It's also a matter of how well-known I am, after all...

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Leader!
Are you okay? Want me to carry that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Listen here, I might look a wee bit small, but I'm a full-fledged Umamusume! I'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right, you're my senior...!
I-I'm so sorry~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haaah..., I really don't got any dignity, do I.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Never mind the races,
at this rate, I'm failin' as a leader too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross found herself fretting a bit over an unexpected hurdle.
